name: Charles Schwab

apr.notes: 0% introductory APR for first 6 months. Then 19.49% to 28.49% variable. Cash Advance APR 28.74%. Penalty APR 29.99%. Variable APRs will not exceed 29.99%. Accurate as of 07/24/26.

fx_fee.notes: 2.7% of each transaction after conversion to US dollars.

credit_required.notes: Excellent or good credit recommended. Must maintain an eligible Schwab account (Schwab One, Schwab General Brokerage, or Schwab Traditional/Roth/Rollover IRA not managed by an independent advisor).

base_rate.description: 1.5% cash back on all eligible purchases, auto-deposited to linked Schwab brokerage account

rewards.redemption_notes: Cash back is 1.5% of dollar amount of eligible purchases. Deposited directly into linked eligible Schwab brokerage account approximately 6-8 weeks after end of billing period. No cash back earned if Minimum Payment Due is not paid by Payment Due Date.

signup_bonus.description: Limited-time offer: $300 cash back (statement credit) after spending $1,000 in first 3 months. Standard offer is $200. Offer ends 7/8/2026.

benefits.title: $0 Annual Fee
benefits.description: No annual fee for the Schwab Investor Card from American Express.

benefits.title: 0% Introductory APR for 6 Months
benefits.description: 0% introductory APR on purchases for first 6 months from account opening, plus 0% introductory plan fee for first 6 months.

other: 2.7% foreign transaction fee makes this card unsuitable for international travel

notes: Schwab Investor Card from American Express. $0 annual fee. 1.5% flat cash back auto-deposited to Schwab brokerage. 2.7% foreign transaction fee. 0% intro APR for 6 months. network_tier is none for Amex.
